newsitem.title: USA: CS First Boston to help cover Orange Cty refunding.
newsitem.headline: CS First Boston to help cover Orange Cty refunding.

text.p: Orange County, California, disclosed on Monday that CS First Boston was negotiating an agreement to contribute up to $4 million to a proposed refunding of county pension obligation bonds.
In return, bondholders would agree not to pursue claims against CS First Boston for its role in the 1994 pension bond issue, the county said in documents obtained by Reuters.
The amount paid by CS First Boston would help cover costs of the county's proposed refunding of nearly $200 million of pension obligation bonds, the county said.
As part of the proposed agreement, neither the county nor CS First Boston would waive any claims that they may have against each other.
CS First Boston has been the subject of an investigation by the Securities and Exchange Commission focusing on the firm's due diligence as underwriter of county pension bonds.
The county said CS First Boston has been advised that the commission had authorized the filing of a civil enforcement action against the firm in connection with the probe.
Orange County filed for bankruptcy protection on December 6, 1994, after sustaining investment losses of more than $1.6 billion. It emerged from bankruptcy in June this year.
